content:
Lena (Support): flagging PulseCare trial — activation funnel dropped from 92% -> 28% starting ~07:40 UTC. moving to CS escalation.
Raj (Support): saw the same. Ticket S-5421 opened. lots of 504s from delivery service and email bounces. sample log excerpt:
```
[2026-04-02T07:41:03Z] POST /v1/activate 504 upstream timeout connect=10s
[2026-04-02T07:42:10Z] EMAIL_SEND id=7f3a status=421 bounce=temporary
```
Nico (CS): taking point. @Lena can you share which customer contacts are on the trial and the renewal window?
Lena (Support): contacts: dana.p@pulsecare.com (PM), kevin@pulsecare.com (CTO). renewal scheduled in 28 days.
Priya (CSM): Ill join customer call and prep an AE brief. renewal <30 days = high risk if unresolved.
Theo (eng-infra): ops-bot shows a canary push to mailer-proxy at 07:35 UTC. I'm pulling deploy logs now.
Ops Bot: deploy mailer-proxy v3.7 initiated 2026-04-02T07:35:21Z, rollout stage=canary, id=dp-7731.
Raj (Support): workaround attempt: enabled local retry with exponential backoff for webhook calls; ~40% of retries succeeded.
Nico (CS): comms plan (short): 1) 08:00 UTC quick ack to customer, 2) 08:20 UTC status update after infra triage, 3) post-mortem and credit proposal within 24h.
Lena (Support): sending immediate ack draft to Dana for approval: "Hi Dana — were aware of activation issues for your trial users starting ~07:40 UTC. Our engineers are investigating; well update at 08:00 and again at 08:30 UTC. Apologies for the disruption"
Priya (CSM): add: "We understand trial momentum matters. If remediation goes beyond 12h well propose proactive credit and a dedicated onboarding session."
Theo (eng-infra): initial findings: canary logs show increased connection resets to customer webhook host from mailer-proxy v3.7. rolling back canary will be immediate mitigation if approved.
Nico (CS): schedule:
- 07:50 UTC internal huddle (nico, priya, theo, lena, raj)
- 08:00 UTC customer ack + call offer (nico + priya)
- 08:30 UTC update with remediation plan (rollback or patch)
- 09:15 UTC AE renewal-impact note posted
Raj (Support): linking ticket S-5421 and attaching sample webhook payloads and bounce headers.
Lena (Support): also seeing ~30 manual inbound emails reporting sign-up failures. forwarding to Dana so she knows were proactively tracking.
Nico (CS): routing this to #cs-escalations and tagging eng-infra. flagging renewal risk: HIGH. Priya please draft AE note with 3 mitigation options: credit, extended trial, or dedicated onboarding hour.
Priya (CSM): will do. prepping the note now; will attach to ticket after call.
Theo (eng-infra): rolling back canary now (rollback id dp-7731). ETA ~6m.
Ops Bot: rollback started for dp-7731 at 07:53:12Z; progress=40%.
Lena (Support): post-rollback status: error rate for /v1/activate dropped to baseline within 3m for the canary hosts; still monitoring full population.
Nico (CS): great. I'll ping Dana and offer a 30m window for a sync at 08:15 UTC to walk through impact and next steps.
Priya (CSM): noted - I'm prepping renewal-impact doc and compensation language (suggest 10% credit + 1-hour onboarding session if >6h disruption).
Raj (Support): keeping the ticket S-5421 updated with webhooks/retries and email delivery metrics.
Nico (CS): owner: @Nico (CS). Handoff checklist: 1) confirm full rollback success, 2) customer comms at 08:00 & 08:30, 3) AE note & compensation proposal, 4) schedule follow-up survey after resolution.
Lena (Support): thanks team. will shout if any error spike returns. :loud_sound:
Priya (CSM): +1. will also plan proactive renewal outreach depending on customer sentiment after the call.
Nico (CS): summary to drop here after 08:15 call with Dana.
